key_points: Enbridge confirmed a $2.6B acquisition of Tallgrass Energy's crude oil transportation business, expanding its Rockies-to-Cushing pipeline network and strengthening connections to major North American producing basins.
The company has deployed ~$3.2B across three deals in two weeks, signaling aggressive but disciplined capital allocation in its core midstream franchise.
Cramer's commentary and the oil price spike narrative reinforce Enbridge's positioning as a defensive, toll-road-style play amid geopolitical volatility.
The M&A activity is notable but not transformational for a company of Enbridge's size; incremental rather than thesis-changing.
High yield (5.8%) and defensive characteristics remain intact, supporting a modestly constructive view over the next several weeks.
